summary: Top floor apartment · Excellent Jesmond location · Private south-facing terrace · Available June 2024
description:
My Property Box are thrilled to welcome to the Lettings market this stunning top floor apartment on Eslington Terrace, Jesmond.

With a communal entrance leading to the first floor, the split-level apartment is entered through private entrance with stairs leading to the lower landing. With a large Velux overhead, you are immediately welcomed to the bright & airy space. To the rear, a modern kitchen equipped with fully integrated appliances and dining table. The kitchen provides access to a south-facing private terrace, a sought after addition to this kind of property. Two double bedrooms accompanied by a family bathroom. To the front of the apartment is the spacious living room, with wall mounted TV and folding blinds.

Tastefully decorated throughout, the apartment is ideal for a pair or couple who desire private, upmarket Jesmond living with convenient access to Jesmond's local amenities & access to the City Centre.

Furnished, available June 2024 with off-street parking to the rear. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
